material.acceptance_criteria: A CI run with the override breaches the open-socket assert and exits non-zero; the normal run stays green.
material.description: The connection-cap job asserts open sockets are within the cap, but never proves that assert would fail if the cap were exceeded. Run the same job once with the cap raised past the admit limit (a named test-only override) and assert the job fails.
material.resolution: The connection-cap job has a control: with the cap raised past the 1000 opened sockets, the same open-socket assert must fail, and the control passes only when it does. Printed connection cap control ok breached=1000 expected_cap=64. The normal cap job is unchanged.
material.subject: Add a control that proves the connection cap assert fails on a real breach
